name: SLT-Mobitel National Data Center, Pitipana
notes: SLT official pages: Pitipana-Homagama iDC opened 2018-01-16, 3-storied building of 5,800 sqm, 24 km from SLT HQ Data Center, 500 racks with up to 5 kW per rack (operator-stated A/B); Uptime Institute lists SLT National Data Center Pitipana-Homagama with Tier III Design and Constructed Facility certifications (A); DCD corroborates 500 racks (B). capacity_mw 2.5 is inferred IT load (500 racks x 5 kW) from operator-stated figures; not a published facility MW.

name: SLT HQ Data Centre / Welikada international backhaul hub
notes: Submarine Networks states SLT connects its cable landing stations to the international backhaul hub at the SLT Welikada premises (B); a Parliament of Sri Lanka report states SLT-Mobitel data centers are located at head office, Welikada and Pitipana National Data Center (A official context). Facility/backhaul lead; capacity U.

name: Dialog Broadband Networks Malabe Data Center #2 (Tier III Media Hub)
developer: Dialog Axiata PLC / Dialog Broadband Networks
notes: Uptime Institute country page lists Dialog Broadband Networks, Malabe, Western Province with Tier III Design and Constructed Facility certifications (A); Dialog 2017 official news names the Tier III Data Centre and Media Hub at Malabe with hosting, colocation and cloud services (A); Peradeniya University field-visit page corroborates it as Sri Lanka's first Tier III certified data centre (B). Capacity not published.

name: Dialog Data Centre, Piliyandala
notes: Dialog official 2021 news announces its latest fully owned data centre in Piliyandala offering hosting, co-location and cloud services (A); DCD corroborates the opening (B); PF Engineering portfolio documents the Converged Data Center Piliyandala for Dialog Axiata with completion 30 April 2021 (B vendor). No separate Uptime entry found; any Tier claim for this site is U/B. Do not merge with Dialog Malabe.

name: Lankacom data center / cloud hosting, Colombo 07
notes: Lankacom official pages state Datacenter and Cloud Hosting Services (A service existence); company address 65C Dharmapala Mawatha, Colombo 07 confirmed by multiple sources incl. APNIC ASN5087 registration record (A entity/address). Physical data-hall details and capacity not published; capacity/certification C/U.

name: MillenniumIT / LSEG Malabe data centre
notes: Sunday Times (2015-12-13) reports MillenniumIT launched Sri Lanka's first privately held Tier 3 data centre (B; 2015 reports cite 80 racks, ~3,000 sq ft raised floor); LSEG official pages confirm the Malabe campus (A campus address); FT confirms LSEG investment in MillenniumIT infrastructure at Malabe (B). Institutional/private facility, not public colo unless service offer found; capacity MW U.

name: National Savings Bank Production Data Center, Colombo
notes: Uptime Institute country page lists National Savings Bank Production Data Center, Colombo, with Tier III Certification of Design Documents (A certification and city-level location). Institutional/bank facility, not public colocation; capacity U.

name: OrionStellar Data Centre, Orion City Colombo
developer: Digital Realty (Pvt) Ltd / OrionStellar (JV Dialog Axiata and St. Anthony's Property Developers)
notes: DCD reported OrionStellar opened a carrier-neutral colocation data center in Colombo's Orion ICT Park with 200 racks and 1.5 MW capacity, TIA Tier-III rated (B; capacity MW named by source); TIA Online lists the facility at Orion City IT Park, 752 Dr. Danister De Silva Mawatha (certifier directory, B/A); EconomyNext confirms launch Nov 2021 as JV of Dialog and St. Anthony's Property Developers (B); Data Center Map lists 1.5 MW/200 racks (C corroboration).

name: Seylan Bank Data Centre, Seylan Towers Colombo 03
notes: Seylan Bank official announcement (2021-07-31) states the bank unveiled its state-of-the-art data centre at Seylan Towers, No. 90, Galle Road, Colombo 03 (A bank-owned source); DCD corroborates the opening (B). Institutional bank facility; no public MW capacity found.

name: OREL IT data centre at Port City Colombo (planned)
developer: OREL IT / Colombo Port City Economic Commission
notes: Business press (Ceylon Business 2026-03-13, Daily Mirror) report Port City Colombo signed a strategic partnership/agreement with OREL IT whose expertise covers data centre solutions, cloud, cybersecurity and managed services (B); Port City official site supports SEZ/business-centre context (A SEZ facts). No official Port City data-centre-specific project page verified; treat as planned lead until a named DC project with site/stage appears.

name: ICTA Lanka Government Cloud / LGN estate
developer: ICTA (Information and Communication Technology Agency of Sri Lanka)
notes: LGC official portal and ICTA pages confirm the Lanka Government Cloud (LGC 2.0) as centralized government cloud infrastructure and ICTA's sovereign-cloud strategy work (A program); readme.lk documents LGC/LGN 2.0 history and outages (B); procurement press reports ICTA completed procurement for a new government cloud (Oct 2025, B) and LGC 3.0 upgrade is planned under the new GovTech authority (2026). Physical data-hall mapping (plausibly SLT Pitipana) is B/U until a primary source names the hall.

name: SLT Colombo Cable Landing Station (SMW4 / Dhiraagu-SLT)
notes: Cable/critical infrastructure: Submarine Networks lists SLT Colombo CLS (SMW4 and Dhiraagu-SLT) as one of five Sri Lanka cable landing stations connected to the SLT Welikada international backhaul hub. Counted as cable/critical facility, not commercial datacenter; no colocation service source.

name: SLT Mount Lavinia Cable Landing Station (SMW3 / Bharat Lanka)
notes: Cable/critical infrastructure: SLT Mount Lavinia CLS hosts SMW3 and the Bharat Lanka Cable System (BSNL India route, inaugurated Sept 2006 per SLT sustainability report). Cable landing station, not commercial datacenter by default.

name: Lanka Bell Colombo Cable Landing Station (FALCON)
notes: Cable/critical infrastructure: Submarine Networks lists Lanka Bell Colombo CLS for FALCON. Cable landing station, not commercial datacenter; operational status should be rechecked per methodology.

name: Dialog Mount Lavinia Cable Landing Station (BBG / Maldives-Sri Lanka)
notes: Cable/critical infrastructure: Dialog Mount Lavinia CLS hosts BBG and the Maldives-Sri Lanka Cable; readme.lk documents a visit to Dialog's BBG landing station (B). MSC operational status should be rechecked; not counted as commercial datacenter.

name: Matara Cable Landing Station (SMW5 / SMW6 / IAX)
developer: Sri Lanka Telecom PLC (SMW5/SMW6); Dialog Axiata (IAX Sri Lanka portion)
notes: Cable/critical infrastructure: Matara CLS at Browns Hill, Matara (Southern Province) is the only verified non-Western cable landing station - SLT full landing status for SEA-ME-WE 5 (B), SEA-ME-WE 6 landed 29 Dec 2024 (B), and the India-Asia-Xpress (IAX) Sri Lankan portion landing at Matara managed by Dialog Axiata is operational per DCD (B). Cable facility, not commercial datacenter.

name: Hambantota data centre (rumor/lead)
notes: No official source found for a Hambantota data centre project in this sweep; Hambantota/Mirijjawila remains an investment-zone and energy lead only. Keep as U until BOI/Port/investor/developer or permit source names a project.
